dedupe_keys.name: simscale urban microclimate simulation cloud cfd for pedestrian wind and thermal comfort

description: SimScale offers browser-based computational fluid dynamics for city-scale pedestrian wind comfort and outdoor thermal comfort studies, with pedestrian wind comfort assessed against the Lawson criteria and the Dutch NEN 8100 standard, and studies of natural ventilation and air-source heat pump exhaust dispersion. The vendor states that Rhino and Revit models import without geometry clean-up and that competition-stage results return in hours, and describes microclimate conditions as decisive for planning approvals. Coverage: any site the user models. Access: commercial cloud subscription with an interactive demo. Licence: proprietary. Caveats: performance and accuracy claims are the vendor's; users must still judge mesh, boundary conditions and validation. Simulation uses: wind and thermal comfort in plazas and streets around new buildings, and checking cooling measures in public space. Related records: urbanMicroclimateFoam, ENVI-met and the Vertical City Weather Generator.
